summary: IT Analyst with 7.9 years of experience administering and troubleshooting 7x24 Linux (RHEL), Solaris, and AIX infrastructure in high-demand production environments. Expertise in CLI-driven automation with Python and Ansible, VMware virtualization, cloud operations (Azure/AWS), and proactive monitoring to maintain SLA and critical system availability.

bullets: Administer and troubleshoot 3,000+ Linux (RHEL), Solaris, and AIX servers in high-demand production environments, resolving L2/L3 incidents related to CPU, memory, disk, services, and user management via CLI to ensure 7x24 operational continuity.

Maintain infrastructure health and security through daily system monitoring, proactive backup verification, vulnerability remediation, and SLA-based incident management for critical Unix environments.
Automate Linux patching, reporting, and maintenance workflows using Python, Ansible, and shell scripting, delivering consistent service improvements and reducing manual effort across 1,500+ servers.
Manage VMware-based Linux virtual environments and execute disaster recovery procedures, collaborating with cross-functional teams to minimize downtime during major outages and scheduled maintenance.
Design and deploy CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code solutions using Terraform, GitLab, Jenkins, Docker, and Kubernetes to provision and govern Azure and AWS cloud resources at scale.

Develop Python CLI tools and API integrations (boto3, Lambda, S3, EC2, ECS) that automate cloud operations, enforce tagging standards, optimize snapshot lifecycle management, and generate significant cost savings.
Implement monitoring and alerting frameworks—including NewRelic and custom certificate-expiry tools—across 100+ servers to preempt service disruptions and uphold infrastructure reliability.
